scope: 96 previously collected first user-to-assistant boundary captures; no model rerun
metric: Four-candidate equal-weight AUROC among validation rows whose account appears anywhere in the complete user instruction

skipped_positions.user_message_end: Not saved at the first boundary for all 96; distance from recipient Tpost was 36 to 108 tokens
skipped_positions.first_tool_to_assistant: Not a complete matched first-boundary capture across all 96 runs

interpretation: Tpost and post-window positions are defined around the condition's declared positive recipient account. Candidate identity can therefore be read from the selected account tokens; their high AUROC does not establish a label-blind recipient-role or goal readout. Tpre is a pre-account control. Earlier positions can precede exposure of a reference account even when that account appears in the complete instruction. Position search and REC/DON reuse occurred after inspecting the original validation result.
